description_expanded: Overview5.0(3 reviews)Pet Friendly - Public Beach-3 Minute Bike Ride, Golf Cart/Option, 3 Bikes `The Turquoise Turtle`The Space Blue Mountain Beach Escape – Pet-Friendly & Perfectly Located! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 4-Minute Bike Ride to the Beach – Quick & easy access to sugar-white sands Walking Distance to Restaurants & Shops – Enjoy local dining & shopping nearby Away from Seaside Crowds – Experience a peaceful, laid-back beach retreat Pet-Friendly – Bring up to 2 furry friends, 30lbs max. along for the adventure! Pet fee and deposit required 3 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s scenic trails & charming beach towns Large Outdoor Deck & Patio – Perfect for dining & relaxing under the stars Fast & Free Wi-Fi – Stay connected while you unwind Parking for 2 Cars – Convenient & hassle-free 6-Seater Golf Cart Rental Option – Cruise 30A in style! Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacationWelcome to Turquoise TurtleLocated on the south side of 30A you will find this beautiful 3-bedroom home in Blue Mountain Beach. Just a short 3-minute bike ride away you will be able to enjoy the sugar-white sand, delicious dining, and shopping. This is the perfect beach home to vacation at and make lifelong memories!As you enter this home you will see a very spacious living and kitchen area allowing plenty of room for friends and family to relax. This living area offers a flatscreen TV and tons of room to unwind. Cook your favorite meal in the fully stocked kitchen before heading to the dining room table or outside to the private patio to enjoy a nice dinner.Off of the dining area you will find a guest bedroom that offers a king-sized bed along with a shared bathroom. As you head upstairs you will find the large master bedroom. This bedroom comes with a king-sized bed and has its own private en suite bathroom. Open the balcony doors and step outside where you will find the best morning coffee spot around. Just across the hall you will find the ideal room for your little ones. This room has two bunk beds and a flat screen TV.If you are looking to be away from the crowd and close to the beach than this is the spot for you. Come soak in the beauty of 30A and explore all that it has to offer!House Rules**No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Beach access is located at Blue Mountain Regional at Hwy 83 (0.8 miles)* CALL FOR MONTHLY SNOWBIRD RATES*** One week notification is required prior to arrival to reserve golf cart** Max 2 Pets - under 30 pounds allowed with $150 non-refundable deposit and $500 refundable deposit. Please contact our office after booking to add your pets to your reservation*** You will be required to be present at the property for any maintenance issues if you are unable to crate or contain your pet.* Walton County does not allow pets on the beach without a permit. In order to obtain a permit, you must be a Walton County resident.* No Cable. Streaming TV Only.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (10)Master Bedroom: Second Floor- King sized bed, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom: First Floor- King sized bed, shared bathroomBunk Room: Second Floor- Two twin bunk beds, private bathroomLiving Room Sleeper SofaGolf Carts: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW:-To operate the golf cart, guests must have a valid drivers license and be at least 21 years old.-Please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations-A copy of the golf carts terms and conditions will be emailed upon reservation and will require signatures-Golf Cart is not guaranteed for any mechanical issues.PLEASE NOTE - ** FL law states that any underage and/or unlicensed driver of a street legal golf cart is considered a criminal offense and a $500 fine including a possible 60 days in jail. It’s a very serious offense for underage/unlicensed driving of a LSV in the State of FL.**Area Attraction:Welcome to Blue Mountain Beach, a hidden gem along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A! Known for its breathtaking white sand beaches, vibrant turquoise waters, and relaxed coastal charm, this community is the perfect destination for those seeking great food, sweet treats, shopping, and outdoor adventures.Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Blue Mountain Bakery, then swing by For the Health of It for quick grocery essentials and organic treats. When it’s time for lunch or dinner, savor fresh seafood and coastal flavors at Red Fish Taco, Shunk Gulley, or Cowgirl Kitchen, all just a short bike ride away. Enjoy some shopping at The Stalls on 30A, where you’ll find unique local treasures and coastal-inspired finds. And when it’s time for something sweet, indulge in homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, just a quick stroll from your doorstep.Whether you’re here to unwind on the beach, explore the area, or simply soak in the laid-back 30A lifestyle, you’ve found the perfect place to stay!Show less
